purpose: Exploratory ETF adaptations; not original-paper replications or investable alpha claims
universe_policy: Fixed surviving ETFs selected for asset-class coverage, not historical performance. NOT survivorship-free. No claims about a point-in-time investable universe.
final_test_policy: Never downloaded/evaluated by normal commands. Future use requires a new registered release protocol and permanent consumed marker.
execution: Signal at previous session close, entry next session adjusted open, exit after H sessions at open. Nonoverlapping cohorts, no intraday fill assertions.
success_rule: Only provisional validation candidates: positive net CAGR and benchmark-relative mean in validation and walk-forward, positive 95% block-bootstrap lower bound for active mean, max-T familywise p<=0.05, positive active mean under 2x and 4x costs, positive active mean in >=2 of 3 walk-forward years. Robust success additionally requires faithful inputs, point-in-time universe audit, and untouched final evaluation; none may qualify from current exploratory data alone.
selection_policy: No fitted hyperparameters; all predeclared variants retained. No best-variant cherry picking. Monthly/long-horizon papers labeled horizon adaptations. Blocked papers not assigned synthetic performance.
multiple_testing: Joint synchronized centered stationary bootstrap of active net daily returns; maximum studentized mean across every tested variant. Reserve 50-paper Bonferroni floor in addition. Does not cover unrecorded human research decisions.
known_limits: Yahoo public adjusted history is revised and not point-in-time
Adjusted OHLC returns approximate reinvested distributions and use synthetic units, not actual historical share cash ledger
Cash yield, taxes and borrow unavailable; long-only no leverage
Opening prices are benchmarks, not guaranteed executions
No full original-paper replication without source methods and original data
